name: Vinh Market
kicker: The market hall and the foam coffee
summary: Walk Chợ Vinh in the morning for the hall and a foam coffee. The cup is black or with milk, and you drink the foam first or stir it in. Hours are check on arrival. The 2019 night market on Cao Thắng, in front of the hall, stopped after a few months.
getThere: In the center. A door number is check on arrival.
heroCaption: The street front of Chợ Vinh, with the hall sign over the entrance
gettingThere: Chợ Vinh is one of the large markets in the center, with Chợ Ga Vinh and Chợ Quán Lau. A street number for this hall is check on arrival. Minutes from the square are check on arrival. Chợ Ga is a different hall.

legs.heading: From the square
legs.body: In the center. The minutes are check on arrival.
